## The problem

What workflow is missing or painful today? Describe the situation, not the solution.

## The idea

Optional. If you have a concrete proposal, describe it. Otherwise leave this blank and the discussion will figure it out.

## Is this in scope?

Check [ROADMAP.md](../../ROADMAP.md) before filing. PIDhound has explicit phase boundaries (v1.x Simple Mode polish, v2 Power User Mode, v3 Proactive, v4 broader workloads, and an "Out of scope (forever)" list). If the idea fits an existing phase, mention which one.

## Classification rules

If this is a "PIDhound doesn't recognize tool X" issue, file it as a Classification rule PR instead — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#most-wanted-contributions). It's a one-file YAML change with a fixture test.
